correctness.rationale: For each finite \(r\), a transcendental \(t\) over the small field \(P\) yields \(P\)-linearly independent powers. The pair-language definable subspaces \(H_i=\sum_{j\ne i}Pa_j\) produce rows of disjoint cosets, and every transversal is realized by an explicit sum. This gives an inp-pattern of depth \(r\) in one singleton variable. The lovely-pair theory is NIP, so burden equals dp-rank. Kim Theorem 10.33 then excludes each finite unary dp-rank cutoff class from the larger preservation framework.
